fusions.name: Slow Swell
fusions.desc: Pushes a swell out in a cone 4 tiles long that deals 10 water damage to everything in it, knocking each hit 2 tiles back and leaving it [Slowed] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Lazy Current
fusions.desc: Sends a slow bolt of water at an enemy that deals 4 water damage and heals you for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Held Moment
fusions.desc: Holds every creature within 5 tiles in place for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Buoyant Frame
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 14, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second.
